category: website uptime, page speed, domain and SSL monitoring

free_tier.stated: Free plan at $0 per month: 10 uptime monitors at a 5-minute test interval, 1 page speed monitor, 1 domain monitor, 1 SSL monitor and alerts through integrations; no server monitors and no free SMS credits
free_tier.notes: The unit counted is the test. The Superior plan is $20.41 per month with 100 uptime monitors at a 1-minute interval and 3 server monitors.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a test checks a target; nothing is stored per object

retention.stated: unverified: no history retention period is stated on the pricing page

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound checker; no export or API access is named on the pricing page

interface_detail: The pricing page names no API for any plan, so the Free plan is reached through the web app and its integrations; the interface vocabulary has no term for a browser-only service.
tooling: the web app and alert integrations
chaining: External uptime tests every 5 minutes on up to 10 endpoints of free-hosted services, with one SSL, one domain and one page speed test.

limits.value: 10 uptime monitors, 1 page speed monitor, 1 domain monitor and 1 SSL monitor on Free
5-minute uptime test interval, 24 hours for page speed and SSL, 7 days for domain tests

binding_note: The 5-minute uptime interval sets the detection delay and the 24-hour page speed and SSL intervals bind the other tests, before the monitor counts matter.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the sign-up page answered a login wall to every page reader and its form was not read; the pricing page offers Try StatusCake for free today and states no credit card term for Free.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page. No account was opened and the sign-up page could not be read, so the sign-up fields, the card term, the history retention and any API are unverified: behind a sign-up.
